clue.text: Cut train in error — it's withdrawn

indicators.note: letters set down in error are jumbled, so the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A clerk has mistakenly cut a train from the timetable and it has been taken out of service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in error' is the anagram signal on the eight letters of 'Cut train'; 'withdrawn' looks like part of the railway story but is the definition, of a person.
explanation.definitionFit: A withdrawn person is reserved and says little, which is what being uncommunicative and silent means.

clue.text: Shelter heaps of veg

parts.note: the lee is the sheltered side, away from the wind
K, a thousand, stands for a great many, heaps

explanation.surface: A gardener keeps piles of vegetables under cover.
explanation.walkthrough: K is the abbreviation for a thousand (as in '50K'), used loosely here for heaps.
explanation.definitionFit: The plant in question is an onion-family vegetable, the national emblem of Wales.

clue.text: Dad's favourite little child

parts.note: pop is an informal word for dad; the possessive just links it to what follows
a pet is a favourite, as in teacher's pet

explanation.surface: A father's best-loved small child.
explanation.definitionFit: An affectionate term for a small child or darling, a common British endearment.

clue.text: Take for granted president has to start again

parts.note: to resume is to start again after a pause

explanation.surface: It is assumed that the president will begin a fresh term.
explanation.definitionFit: To assume something without proof is to take it as given, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Security device makes mum more embarrassed

parts.note: mum as in 'keep mum' means be quiet, so it gives the hush SH
an embarrassed face goes red, so more embarrassed is redder

explanation.surface: A security gadget leaves a mother even more mortified.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mum' is not mother but the call for silence, SH.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine that cuts documents into strips keeps confidential papers from being read, so it is a security device.

clue.text: Disheartened when fighter aircraft with corrosion gets admired

parts.note: F is the prefix for fighter aircraft, as in F-16
rust is the corrosion of iron
to be rated is to be thought highly of, admired

explanation.surface: A pilot is downcast when a rusty fighter plane is still praised.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone thwarted and discouraged feels let down, which is a close synonym of disheartened.

clue.text: Others keep an alternative rendezvous

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it within, so one piece holds the other inside it

parts.note: the rest means the others
or is the word that introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: Other people keep a second meeting place in reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: A holiday destination or haunt is a place people go to, a meeting place or rendezvous.

clue.text: Set out for a nice drink

indicators.note: letters set out are laid out afresh, so the three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone sets off to have a pleasant drink.
explanation.definitionFit: This French phrase means black coffee, served without milk, a drink.

clue.text: Stockings getting runs in clothes drier

indicators.note: the runs go in the stockings, one piece placed inside the other

parts.note: hose is an old collective word for stockings
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Stockings laddering while they hang on the airer.
explanation.walkthrough: A clothes horse is a wooden frame for drying laundry; 'runs' looks like ladders in tights but is the scorer's R.
explanation.definitionFit: A clothes horse is a frame for airing washing, so the single word stands for a clothes drier.

clue.text: Devil can steal

definitions.meaning: the can is slang for prison

explanation.surface: The Devil is perfectly able to thieve.
explanation.walkthrough: Three definitions in a row: 'can' is not the verb but the noun for jail.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang uses the one word for the Devil (Old Nick), a prison and stealing.

clue.text: Soprano rejected term of ownership

indicators.note: something rejected is thrown back, so this piece is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: SOP is an abbreviation for soprano
a session is a term, as a period of sitting or study

explanation.surface: A singer turns down a fixed period of owning something.
explanation.definitionFit: Having something in your keeping and control is holding title to it, i.e. ownership.

clue.text: University College during religious festival is brilliant

indicators.note: one thing during another sits within it, so this piece goes inside

parts.note: Lent is the Christian season before Easter
UC is the abbreviation for University College

explanation.surface: A college's showing in the church season is outstanding.
explanation.definitionFit: Lucent is a literary word for shining or giving off light, i.e. brilliant.

clue.text: More protection for fielder

parts.note: extra means more
cover is protection

explanation.surface: A fielder needs extra padding.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, extra cover is a fielding position on the off side, between cover and mid-off.
explanation.definitionFit: The cricket position names the player stationed there, so it is a fielder.

clue.text: Restrained friend when crossing river

indicators.note: the friend crosses over the river, spanning it, so one piece wraps the other

parts.note: mate is British for friend
the Oder is a river between Germany and Poland

explanation.surface: A friend held back while fording a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Moderate behaviour avoids extremes, so it is restrained and measured.

clue.text: Peacekeepers stay or come away

parts.note: UN peacekeepers are United Nations troops
to stick is to stay put

explanation.surface: The peacekeepers must decide whether to remain or leave.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that unsticks comes loose and separates, which is to come away.

clue.text: Clergyman having fool in church is in a deep hole

indicators.note: the clergyman and fool are placed in the church, inside it

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
Rev, Reverend, is a clergyman's title
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A vicar who brings a fool into church is in deep trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep crack in a glacier is a deep hole in the ice.

clue.text: Old jerk in time for peep show?

indicators.note: the old jerk sits in the time, inside it

parts.note: an era is a period of time
a tic is an involuntary jerk

explanation.surface: An old lecher in his day was a peep-show regular.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that a peep show is only an example of the kind of entertainment meant.
explanation.definitionFit: Sexually arousing material is the sort of thing a peep show offers, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Person shows cute rear when dancing

indicators.note: letters dancing move about, so the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone shows off a pert bottom on the dance floor.
explanation.definitionFit: A being, especially in phrases such as 'poor thing', is a person.

clue.text: Apprehension is likely during treatment

indicators.note: one thing during another falls within it, so this piece goes inside

parts.note: a cure is a treatment
apt means likely, as in apt to happen

explanation.surface: Anxiety tends to arise while undergoing therapy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Apprehension' reads as worry but is meant as arrest.
explanation.definitionFit: Apprehension also means arrest, seizing someone, which is taking them prisoner.

clue.text: Goddess keeps a bar in dance

indicators.note: the goddess keeps the pieces, holding them within her

parts.note: Hera is the Greek queen of the gods
to ban is to bar

explanation.surface: A goddess runs a bar inside a dance hall.
explanation.definitionFit: This slow Cuban dance in duple time is famous from Bizet's Carmen.

clue.text: American in car damaged plant

indicators.note: something damaged is knocked out of shape, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: An American in a crashed car needs some herbal remedy.
explanation.definitionFit: Arnica is a yellow-flowered mountain plant used in bruise remedies.

clue.text: Boys eat — that is a convenience

indicators.note: to eat is to take inside, so the boys hold the other piece within

parts.note: lads are boys
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: The boys are having a meal; that's handy.
explanation.walkthrough: A convenience, in British usage, is a public toilet.
explanation.definitionFit: A public convenience is a toilet, and the women's one is signed by this word.

clue.text: Appetite overwhelms commander that will eat everything

indicators.note: to overwhelm is to engulf, so the appetite closes around the other piece

parts.note: lust is a strong appetite or craving
OC is Officer Commanding, a commander

explanation.surface: A commander is consumed by a craving to devour everything.
explanation.definitionFit: Swarms of this grasshopper strip crops bare, an insect famed for consuming all in its path.

clue.text: Cranium not broken? Hard-headed!

indicators.note: something broken is in pieces, so the letters of the two words are reassembled

explanation.surface: A skull that has not cracked must be a tough head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hard-headed' looks like it belongs to the skull but means practical and unsentimental; the exclamation mark points up the pun.
explanation.definitionFit: Being hard-headed means being practical and realistic, without sentiment or fancy.

clue.text: Sanction tenor, one from eastern Europe

parts.note: to let is to allow, sanction

explanation.surface: A tenor from Eastern Europe gets permission to perform.
explanation.definitionFit: A Lett is an old name for a Latvian, a person from the Baltic.

clue.text: German composer short of good fortune

indicators.note: short of means lacking, so the letter for good is dropped

parts.note: Christoph Willibald Gluck was a German opera composer

explanation.surface: A German composer lacking good fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: Luck and fortune are synonyms for chance that favours or harms you.

clue.text: Charlie cuts and bites

parts.note: Charlie is the radio alphabet word for C
to hew is to cut, as with an axe

explanation.surface: Charlie slices and nibbles his food.
explanation.definitionFit: To chew is to bite repeatedly, so the plural forms match.

clue.text: Others smoke when having treatment

parts.note: the rest are the others
to cure meat or fish is to preserve it, for example by smoking

explanation.surface: Other patients light up while undergoing treatment.
explanation.definitionFit: A rest cure is a regime of bed rest prescribed as medical treatment.
